requirements.requirement: Physically motivated reversible model with shared geometry
requirements.finding: Fixed two-basin geometry, symmetric saddles, and exact energy-conserving canonical collision realization; idealized stochastic assumptions explicit.

requirements.requirement: Moderate energies, barriers, rates and temperatures across the robustness domain
Finite-time distance advantage at resolved distances
requirements.finding: Mode 1 covers full +/-5% box and u in [0.4,0.8]: Dh<=0.9Dc, Dc>=0.001. Interval length0.4tau exceeds0.25tau.

requirements.requirement: Time savings at every threshold and all simultaneous +/-5% perturbations
requirements.finding: Modes2,3,6 bracket all roots; mode4 proves cold concavity; mode5 proves hot-root monotonicity; modes7,8 prove both sufficient endpoint cases. Analytic reduction yields th<=0.95tc for every threshold in[.001,.01].

requirements.requirement: Independent verification, explicit numerical error and reproducibility
requirements.finding: Fresh source-bound coverage replay, 70-digit direct-exponential and derivative cross-check, false-claim controls, and separate nominal uniformization certificate. Reviewable interval proof, not Lean or external peer review.

requirements.requirement: Report methods, metrics, mechanism, physical limits and search history
requirements.finding: KL distance versus threshold time, absolute and normalized clocks, alternative-distance diagnostics, rejected candidates, exact stochastic bath and separate coarse-graining sensitivity recorded. No material, experimental, global-optimum or new-triplet-counterexample claim.

requirements.requirement: Preserve focused paper and archived original; retain appendices
requirements.finding: Preserved baseline hashes or the verified equation-15 typography revision match; focused paper remains10 pages. Updated report and appendices compile and were rendered for separate visual inspection.

focused_typography_revision.change: Restore one missing LaTeX backslash in equation 15.
focused_typography_revision.visual_check: This function checks extracted text only. Hash-bound visual inspection is recorded separately in browser_and_pdf_review.json.

scope: Research goal achieved for an idealized reversible stochastic rate model at the predeclared quantitative benchmarks. No experimentally demonstrated cooling, preparation-cost advantage, universal metric claim, or material validation.
visual_review: Recorded separately by the authoring agent; this script checks text/artifact consistency, not page pixels.
